seo_content.p_improve: High CPS sirf taqat nahi, technique hai. Apne haath ko relax rakhein taaki dard na ho. Achi gaming mouse use karein (jaise Logitech ya Razer). Roz 10 minute practice karein.
seo_content.h2_styles: Butterfly vs Jitter Click: Kaunsa behtar hai?
seo_content.p_styles: **Jitter Click** mein haath ko vibrate karke 12-14 CPS milta hai, jo aim ke liye acha hai. **Butterfly Click** mein do ungliyon ka use hota hai 20+ CPS ke liye, jo Minecraft Bedwars mein 'Bridging' ke liye zaroori hai.
seo_content.h2_record: CPS ka World Record kya hai?
seo_content.p_record: 10 second mein legitimate record lagbhag 22-24 CPS hai. Lekin **Drag Click** technique se kuch players 30+ CPS tak pahunch jate hain.
seo_content.h2_useful: Gaming mein CPS kyu zaroori hai?
seo_content.p_useful: Minecraft PvP mein high CPS 'Knockback' kam karta hai aur combo marne mein madad karta hai. BGMI aur Free Fire mein tez tap karne se pistol firing tez hoti hai.
seo_content.h2_hardware: Kya aapka mouse apne aap Double Click kar raha hai?
seo_content.p_hardware: Agar aap ek baar click karein aur PC do baar register kare, toh mouse ka switch kharab hai. Hamara 'Mouse Test' tool use karein naya mouse khareedne se pehle.
seo_content.p_games: Tez click karne ka faida nahi agar nishana chook jaye. Hamara **Reaction Test** use karein. Pro esports players ka reaction time 150ms se kam hota hai.
seo_content.h2_hook: Phone screen atak rahi hai? (Ghost Touch)
seo_content.p_hook: Kya BGMI khelte waqt aim apne aap hil raha hai? Ye 'Ghost Touch' hai. Hamara Touch Screen Test use karein ye check karne ke liye ki screen kharab hai ya bas gandi hai.
seo_content.h2_science: Internet tez hai fir bhi Lag ho raha hai?
seo_content.p_science: Ye **Packet Loss** ho sakta hai. Game ka data beech mein kho raha hai. Speedtest sirf download speed batata hai, hum connection ki STABILITY check karte hain.
seo_content.p_gaming: Kya aap bhagte hue jump aur reload nahi kar pa rahe? Ye 'Ghosting' hai. Saste keyboards 3 button ek saath nahi le paate. Yahan check karein apna keyboard.
seo_content.p_technique: Ungli ko mouse par ghiss kar friction se tez click karna Drag Click hai. Iske liye Grip Tape aur matte mouse chahiye hota hai.

q1.question: Normal mouse par Drag Click kaise karein?
q1.answer: Office mouse par mushkil hai. Matte surface wala mouse chahiye. Tape (Grip Tape) lagane se madad milti hai.

q2.question: Valorant/BGMI mein Aim kaise sudharein?
q2.answer: Sirf click speed kaafi nahi. DPI kam karein (400-800), mouse acceleration band karein aur Crosshair Placement par dhyaan dein.

q3.question: Mera keyboard Mechanical hai ya nahi?
q3.answer: Ek keycap nikalein. Agar plus (+) shape ka switch dikhe (Blue/Red), toh mechanical hai. Agar rubber dikhe, toh membrane hai.

q4.question: Kya Jitter Clicking haath ke liye bura hai?
q4.answer: Galat tarike se karne par haan. Dard hone par ruk jayein aur haath ko stretch karein.

q5.question: Butterfly Click ke liye best mouse?
q5.answer: Glorious Model O aur Logitech G Pro X best hain kyunki unmein double click allow karne ki setting hoti hai.

q6.question: Polling Rate (Hz) kya hai?
q6.answer: Mouse PC ko kitni baar signal bhejta hai. Gaming ke liye 1000Hz zaroori hai.

q7.question: Mouse cursor kyu atak raha hai?
q7.answer: Sensor par dhool ho sakti hai. Earbud se saaf karein.

q8.question: Double Click issue kaise check karein?
q8.answer: Hamara 'Mouse Test' use karein. 100 baar click karein. Agar count 100 se zyada hai, toh mouse kharab hai.

q9.question: Average insaan ka CPS kya hai?
q9.answer: Average 6-7 CPS hota hai. Gamers 8-10 tak jate hain.

q10.question: FPS games ke liye best DPI?
q10.answer: Low DPI (400-800) best hai accuracy ke liye.

q11.question: Kya Mechanical Keyboard se speed badhti hai?
q11.answer: Haan, buttons jaldi register hote hain, jisse movement fast hoti hai.

q12.question: Controller Drift kaise theek karein?
q12.answer: Stick ke neeche phoonk maarein (blow air). Dhool nikalne se theek ho sakta hai.

q13.question: Jio Fiber hone par bhi ping high kyu hai?
q13.answer: Download speed aur Ping alag hain. Gaming ke liye LAN cable use karein, WiFi nahi.

q14.question: Keyboard Ghosting kya hai?
q14.answer: Jab keyboard ek saath dabaye gaye keys ko register nahi karta.

q15.question: Mic mein shor (noise) kaise check karein?
q15.answer: Hamara Mic Test use karein. Agar chup rehne par bhi line hil rahi hai, toh shor hai.

q1.question: Reaction time kya hai?
q1.answer: Dimag ko signal process karke ungli hilane mein laga waqt.

q2.question: Acha reaction time kya hai?
q2.answer: Average 250ms hai. 200ms se kam bohot acha hai.

q3.question: Reflexes kaise badhayein?
q3.answer: Shooting games khelein aur achi neend lein.

q4.question: Kya umar se reaction kam hota hai?
q4.answer: Haan, 24 saal ke baad thoda slow ho jata hai.

q6.question: Audio vs Visual reaction?
q6.answer: Audio reaction (170ms) visual se tez hoti hai. Headphone pehnein.

q7.question: Coffee peene se faida hota hai?
q7.answer: Thoda faida hai, par zyada peene se haath kaanpne lagte hain.

q8.question: Wireless mouse slow hota hai?
q8.answer: Nahi, aajkal ke wireless mouse wired jitne hi tez hain.

q9.question: Input Lag kya hai?
q9.answer: Click karne aur screen par action hone ke beech ka delay.

q1.question: WPM kya hai?
q1.answer: Words Per Minute (Shabd Prati Minute). Typing speed naapne ka tarika.

q2.question: Tez kaise type karein?
q2.answer: Touch Typing seekhein. Keyboard na dekhein.

q4.question: Bina dekhe type karna behtar hai?
q4.answer: Haan, isse galti kam hoti hai aur speed badhti hai.

q5.question: Kaunsa switch typing ke liye best hai?
q5.answer: Blue switches typing ke liye best hain (clicky sound).

q6.question: Laptop keyboard kharab hai kya?
q6.answer: Mechanical keyboard hamesha behtar hota hai.

q8.question: Accuracy ka kya matlab hai?
q8.answer: Sahi shabd type karne ka percentage.

q9.question: Haath dard se kaise bachein?
q9.answer: Haath seedha rakhein aur wrist rest use karein.

q10.question: Keyboard layout zaroori hai?
q10.answer: India mein QWERTY chalta hai. Wahi use karein.

q1.question: Ghosting kya hai?
q1.answer: Jab keyboard button press miss kar deta hai.

q2.question: NKRO kya hai?
q2.answer: Saare buttons ek saath dabane par bhi kaam karna.

q4.question: Membrane vs Mechanical?
q4.answer: Membrane sasta hai, Mechanical tez aur durable hai.

q5.question: Keycap kaise nikalein?
q5.answer: Keycap puller se. Haath se kheenchne par toot sakta hai.

q6.question: Optical Switch kya hai?
q6.answer: Light se chalne wala switch, bohot tez hota hai.

q7.question: Spacebar awaaz kyu karta hai?
q7.answer: Lube (grease) lagane se awaaz kam ho jayegi.

q8.question: TKL kya hai?
q8.answer: Bina number pad wala chota keyboard.

q9.question: Chattering kya hai?
q9.answer: Jab ek baar dabane par do baar type ho jaye.

q10.question: Keyboard dho sakte hain?
q10.answer: Nahi! Sirf hawa aur kapde se saaf karein.

seo.title: Touch Test - Ghost Touch Check
seo.description: Phone screen test karein. Dead zones aur Ghost Touch dhoondein.

content.h2_hook: Kya phone apne aap click kar raha hai? (Ghost Touch)
content.p_hook: Agar BGMI mein aim apne aap hil raha hai, toh ye 'Ghost Touch' hai. Ye tool batayega ki screen kharab hai ya nahi.
content.p_science: Hum ek grid dikhate hain. Ungli ghumao. Agar koi dabba green nahi hua, toh wo hissa kharab hai.
content.p_gaming: Agar aap 4 finger claw khelte hain, toh saari ungliyan screen par rakhein. Ye tool batayega kitne touch kaam kar rahe hain.
content.p_hardware: Sasta charger ya mota screen guard aksar wajah hota hai. Charger hatake check karein.
content.p_technique: Screen saaf karein (paseena/tel). Cover nikalein. Phone restart karein.

seo.title: Mic Test - Shor aur Volume Check
seo.description: Mic aur headphone test karein. Awaaz ki quality check karein.

content.h2_hook: Discord par awaaz kharab aa rahi hai?
content.p_hook: Game se pehle mic check karein. Shor ya dheemi awaaz game kharab kar sakti hai. Yahan free mein test karein.
content.p_science: Ye tool aapki awaaz dikhata hai. Agar graph nahi hil raha, toh mic mute hai ya kharab hai.
content.p_gaming: Headphone ulta toh nahi pehna? Hamara test batayega awaaz left se aa rahi hai ya right se.
content.p_hardware: Hum earphone mic, USB mic aur laptop mic sab test karte hain. Browser mein 'Allow' zaroor karein.
content.p_technique: Windows setting mein 'Microphone Boost' kam karein. Earthing kharab hone se bhi shor aata hai.

seo.title: Controller Test PS4/PS5/Xbox - Drift Check
seo.description: Buttons aur analog stick test karein. Stick Drift check karne ka tool.

content.h2_hook: Player apne aap chal raha hai? (Stick Drift)
content.p_hook: PS5 aur Xbox controller ki sabse badi problem 'Drift' hai. Yahan check karein ki stick seedhi hai ya nahi.
content.p_science: Hum X aur Y value dikhate hain. Agar bina chuye number badal rahe hain, toh drift hai.
content.p_gaming: PS4, PS5, Xbox aur local USB controllers sab chalenge. Bas connect karein.
content.p_hardware: 'Vibrate' par click karke motor check karein. L2/R2 button ka pressure bhi check kar sakte hain.
content.p_technique: Analog stick mein phoonk maarein (blow air). Ya game setting mein 'Deadzone' badha dein.

seo.title: Packet Loss Test - Lag Check Karein
seo.description: Net tez hai par game atak raha hai? Packet Loss aur Jitter check karein.

content.h2_hook: Ping kam hai fir bhi teleport ho raha hai?
content.p_hook: Ye 'Packet Loss' hai. Game ka data beech mein gir raha hai. Speedtest ye nahi batata.
content.p_science: Ping ka baar-baar kam zyada hona. Stable 50ms behtar hai 20ms se jo baar baar 100ms ho jaye.
content.p_gaming: Gaming ke liye WiFi use NA karein. LAN cable lagayein taaki 0% loss mile.
content.p_hardware: Agar loss hai toh router restart karein. Agar fir bhi hai toh Jio/Airtel ki galti hai.
content.p_technique: Background download band karein. Ghar ke baaki phone WiFi se hatayein.
